# 2/2 on #925, runs 38965689543 + its 01:01Z retry):
#   1. The fetch carries a FORCE DESTINATION refspec. The bare
#      `refs/heads/<branch>` refspec materializes NO
#      refs/remotes/origin/<branch> tracking ref in an actions/checkout
#      single-branch clone (remote.origin.fetch is pinned to the head
#      branch), so the checkout below failed to resolve the ref (rc 128
#      `fatal: invalid reference` on modern git) — or, where the ref did
#      resolve, hit a branch whose tree carries no store and died with the
#      gh-944 `error: pathspec '.dmtools/fa-sessions' did not match any
#      file(s) known to git`. Under `bash -e` either shape killed the leg.
#      `+` (force): persist force-pushes the branch.
#   2. The checkout is guarded by `git ls-tree`: a branch that exists but
#      carries no session store (the first-session shape — acceptance (a))
#      is a clean "starting fresh" no-op, never a pathspec error.
  if git fetch --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/$FA_SESS_BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH"; then
    if [ -n "$(git ls-tree --name-only "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions)" ]; then
      git checkout "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions
      # Unstage (checkout <ref> -- <path> STAGES): the session store
      # belongs on the fa-sess branch only.
      git restore --staged .dmtools/fa-sessions
      echo "→ fa session restored from $FA_SESS_BRANCH"
    else
      echo "→ $FA_SESS_BRANCH carries no fa session store — starting fresh"
    fi
  else
    echo "→ no saved fa session yet ($FA_SESS_BRANCH absent) — starting fresh"
  fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Extracted from .github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml
# @ a4cd62f (step: Restore fa session (resume the ticket conversation)) — stage-2 de-bloat.
# Engine-side since dmtools-agents#943 (the only source; shipped in the
# factory-setup zip). Invoke with `bash -e` (the GH runner default shell for
# inline `run:`); env block stays on the workflow step.
#
# gh-944 deviation from the a4cd62f byte-shape (first-session dev legs died
# 2/2 on #925, runs 38965689543 + its 01:01Z retry):
#   1. The fetch carries a FORCE DESTINATION refspec. The bare
#      `refs/heads/<branch>` refspec materializes NO
#      refs/remotes/origin/<branch> tracking ref in an actions/checkout
#      single-branch clone (remote.origin.fetch is pinned to the head
#      branch), so the checkout below failed to resolve the ref (rc 128
#      `fatal: invalid reference` on modern git) — or, where the ref did
#      resolve, hit a branch whose tree carries no store and died with the
#      gh-944 `error: pathspec '.dmtools/fa-sessions' did not match any
#      file(s) known to git`. Under `bash -e` either shape killed the leg.
#      `+` (force): persist force-pushes the branch.
#   2. The checkout is guarded by `git ls-tree`: a branch that exists but
#      carries no session store (the first-session shape — acceptance (a))
#      is a clean "starting fresh" no-op, never a pathspec error.
  if git fetch --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/$FA_SESS_BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH"; then
    if [ -n "$(git ls-tree --name-only "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions)" ]; then
      git checkout "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions
      # Unstage (checkout <ref> -- <path> STAGES): the session store
      # belongs on the fa-sess branch only.
      git restore --staged .dmtools/fa-sessions
      echo "→ fa session restored from $FA_SESS_BRANCH"
    else
      echo "→ $FA_SESS_BRANCH carries no fa session store — starting fresh"
    fi
  else
    echo "→ no saved fa session yet ($FA_SESS_BRANCH absent) — starting fresh"
  fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Extracted from .github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml
# @ a4cd62f (step: Restore fa session (resume the ticket conversation)) — stage-2 de-bloat.
# Engine-side since dmtools-agents#943 (the only source; shipped in the
# factory-setup zip). Invoke with `bash -e` (the GH runner default shell for
# inline `run:`); env block stays on the workflow step.
#
# gh-944 deviation from the a4cd62f byte-shape (first-session dev legs died
# 2/2 on #925, runs 38965689543 + its 01:01Z retry):
#   1. The fetch carries a FORCE DESTINATION refspec. The bare
#      `refs/heads/<branch>` refspec materializes NO
#      refs/remotes/origin/<branch> tracking ref in an actions/checkout
#      single-branch clone (remote.origin.fetch is pinned to the head
#      branch), so the checkout below failed to resolve the ref (rc 128
#      `fatal: invalid reference` on modern git) — or, where the ref did
#      resolve, hit a branch whose tree carries no store and died with the
#      gh-944 `error: pathspec '.dmtools/fa-sessions' did not match any
#      file(s) known to git`. Under `bash -e` either shape killed the leg.
#      `+` (force): persist force-pushes the branch.
#   2. The checkout is guarded by `git ls-tree`: a branch that exists but
#      carries no session store (the first-session shape — acceptance (a))
#      is a clean "starting fresh" no-op, never a pathspec error.
  if git fetch --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/$FA_SESS_BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH"; then
    if [ -n "$(git ls-tree --name-only "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions)" ]; then
      git checkout "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions
      # Unstage (checkout <ref> -- <path> STAGES): the session store
      # belongs on the fa-sess branch only.
      git restore --staged .dmtools/fa-sessions
      echo "→ fa session restored from $FA_SESS_BRANCH"
    else
      echo "→ $FA_SESS_BRANCH carries no fa session store — starting fresh"
    fi
  else
    echo "→ no saved fa session yet ($FA_SESS_BRANCH absent) — starting fresh"
  fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Extracted from .github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml
# @ a4cd62f (step: Restore fa session (resume the ticket conversation)) — stage-2 de-bloat.
# Engine-side since dmtools-agents#943 (the only source; shipped in the
# factory-setup zip). Invoke with `bash -e` (the GH runner default shell for
# inline `run:`); env block stays on the workflow step.
#
# gh-944 deviation from the a4cd62f byte-shape (first-session dev legs died
# 2/2 on #925, runs 38965689543 + its 01:01Z retry):
#   1. The fetch carries a FORCE DESTINATION refspec. The bare
#      `refs/heads/<branch>` refspec materializes NO
#      refs/remotes/origin/<branch> tracking ref in an actions/checkout
#      single-branch clone (remote.origin.fetch is pinned to the head
#      branch), so the checkout below failed to resolve the ref (rc 128
#      `fatal: invalid reference` on modern git) — or, where the ref did
#      resolve, hit a branch whose tree carries no store and died with the
#      gh-944 `error: pathspec '.dmtools/fa-sessions' did not match any
#      file(s) known to git`. Under `bash -e` either shape killed the leg.
#      `+` (force): persist force-pushes the branch.
#   2. The checkout is guarded by `git ls-tree`: a branch that exists but
#      carries no session store (the first-session shape — acceptance (a))
#      is a clean "starting fresh" no-op, never a pathspec error.
  if git fetch --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/$FA_SESS_BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH"; then
    if [ -n "$(git ls-tree --name-only "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions)" ]; then
      git checkout "refs/remotes/origin/$FA_SESS_BRANCH" -- .dmtools/fa-sessions
      # Unstage (checkout <ref> -- <path> STAGES): the session store
      # belongs on the fa-sess branch only.
      git restore --staged .dmtools/fa-sessions
      echo "→ fa session restored from $FA_SESS_BRANCH"
    else
      echo "→ $FA_SESS_BRANCH carries no fa session store — starting fresh"
    fi
  else
    echo "→ no saved fa session yet ($FA_SESS_BRANCH absent) — starting fresh"
  fi

# pr-945 rework — CI `crap` gate root cause fixed

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (blocking)**: the `Quality / crap` check on head `42961a6`/`bf63a43e` failed with exactly one ratchet finding:

  ```
  CRAP Ratchet
  ============
  REGRESSION  js/sm/sources/githubSource.js::matchesGuards: 93.5 -> 94.4
  1 regression(s), 0 new over threshold, 0 improvement(s), 0 removed
  ```

  Root cause: the PR's new `noOpenPr` guard branch (`if (hasOpenLinkedPr(q, item)) return false;`) added a decision to `matchesGuards`, a function locked by the released CRAP baseline (`93.5`). The ratchet policy is CRAP-may-only-decrease — any added decision on a baseline-locked function is a regression regardless of coverage.
- **Merge state**: the branch was mid-merge with `origin/main` (`c3811c6d`, ubuntu-latest leg pin) resolved but uncommitted; concluded the merge — the resulting tree is identical to remote `bf63a43e` (same conflicts, same resolution).
- The 6 open "threads" are machine gate notices (red-head arming + rework-consume audit), not code findings; each gets a factual reply in `outputs/review_replies.json`.

## Approach

TDD RED→GREEN on the CI failure itself:

1. **RED** — replicated the CI job locally: installed the pinned `IstiN/crap4js@83ee620` + `nyc@17`, instrumented the tree, ran the full unit suite under coverage (`ci/run_with_coverage.js`), downloaded the released `crap-baseline.json` asset, ran the ratchet → exact reproduction: `REGRESSION ... 93.5 -> 94.4`, exit rc 2.
2. **GREEN** — the fix makes the added guard complexity-neutral instead of reverting the feature. Inside `matchesGuards`, the `mergeState` and `notMergeState` sites each inlined the exact string-or-list normalization expression (`Array.isArray(want) ? want : (want ? [want] : null)`) that already existed as the `rollupWant` helper. Both sites now route through that helper (renamed to the carrier-neutral `wantList`, since it normalizes mergeState lists too): **4 decisions removed vs +1 added by the guard** → net below the released baseline. Measured `93.5 -> 90.4`, `0 regression(s), 1 improvement(s)`, ratchet exit 0 — on merge, the baseline ratchets down.
3. Behavior is unchanged: identical `string|string[] → string[]|null` normalization, same fail-closed `mergeState`/`notMergeState` semantics; the existing guard tests (incl. the `noOpenPr` OPEN/MERGED/PR-less cases) cover the refactored paths, and the harness failure set before vs after the fix is byte-identical (92 known mock-gap failures on both sides — no new failures).
4. Pushed as `3b302940` — validation re-runs on the new head (validate-fresh).

## Files Modified

- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — `matchesGuards`: deduplicated the two inline string-or-list normalizations through the shared `wantList` helper (renamed from `rollupWant`; +comment documenting the CRAP-offset constraint). 11 insertions, 5 deletions.
- `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml` — concluded the already-staged merge resolution from `origin/main` (runner pin to `ubuntu-latest`; no new edits).

## Test Coverage

- `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — **2968 passed, 0 failed** (canonical green gate).
- CRAP ratchet vs the released baseline (local replication of the `Quality / crap` job) — **`0 regression(s), 1 improvement(s)`** (`matchesGuards: 93.5 → 90.4`); RED state first reproduced verbatim (`93.5 → 94.4`, rc 2) before the fix.
- Node harness A/B: failure set identical pre/post fix (92 known mock-gap failures both runs) — the refactor is behavior-preserving.
- Existing guard regression tests stay green: `noOpenPr` OPEN-excluded / MERGED-PR + PR-less eligible, `dev-on-assignment` rule shape, `mergeState`/`notMergeState` list forms.
